meaning:
1) to drive, drive away, drive asunder
1a) (Qal) to drive about
1b)(Niphal) to be driven, be driven about

elsewhere.note: “ ‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to…
Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.
Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.
The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven away, and be no more.
